text:
The Nifty 50 edged up to 25,044.65, a modest 0.06% gain, while the broader Nifty 500 rose 0.47% to 23,567.0. Advances outpaced declines (314 vs 174) giving a healthy breadth score of 71.8, and the market stayed well above its 20‑day moving average (75.3% of stocks). The Bank Nifty led the rally, up 1.11% to 59,741.25, reflecting a wider move across most sectors.

Foreign Institutional Investors (FIIs) were net buyers of about ₹7,212 crore, extending a nine‑day buying streak, whereas Domestic Institutional Investors (DIIs) sold roughly ₹7,173 crore, marking a seven‑day net outflow. The options market shows a put‑call ratio (PCR) of 1.07 for Nifty and 1.27 for Bank Nifty, indicating slightly more put interest. Max‑pain levels sit at 25,000 for Nifty and 57,700 for Bank Nifty, with support walls around those points and resistance near 26,000 (Nifty) and 58,000 (Bank Nifty).

Watch the 25,000‑25,500 range for Nifty; a break below the pivot (24,989) could test the first support at 24,894, while a move above the resistance at 26,000 may trigger fresh buying. For Bank Nifty, the key zone is 59,453‑60,029; a slip under 59,165 could invite further selling, whereas holding above 58,000 may sustain the rally. Keep an eye on US equity momentum and oil price swings, as they have been influencing domestic sentiment.
